files.note: TIGERweb tigerWMS_Current layers 82 (Counties), 22 (County Subdivisions = barrios), 8 (Census Tracts), STATE='72'. lon/lat = internal point (INTPTLON/INTPTLAT). land_km2 = AREALAND / 1e6. population/housing_units only if the layer carries POP100/HU100 (fields seen: MTFCC,OID,GEOID,STATE,COUNTY,TRACT,BASENAME,NAME,LSADC,FUNCSTAT,AREALAND,AREAWATER,STGEOMETRY,CENTLAT,CENTLON,INTPTLAT,INTPTLON,OBJECTID).

HUD Public_Housing_Developments, STD_ST='PR' (304 records). Key = development code. units = TOTAL_DWELLING_UNITS, occupied_units = TOTAL_OCCUPIED, occupancy_pct = PCT_OCCUPIED, residents = PEOPLE_TOTAL, avg_household_income_usd = HH_INCOME, pct_elderly = PCT_AGE62PLUS, pct_disabled = PCT_DISABLED_ALL (HUD negative codes = not available, left out). built_year = year of (no date field found: not set). Municipio from the record's county FIPS. municipio.public_housing_units = sum of units of linked developments.
HUD MULTIFAMILY_PROPERTIES_ASSISTED, Puerto Rico (196 records). Key = mf-<PROPERTY_ID>. owner = owner organisation when the layer has it, else the management agent.

HUD LIHTC database, PROJ_ST='PR' (231 records). Key = lihtc-<HUD_ID>. units = N_UNITS, assisted_units = LI_UNITS (low-income units), placed_in_service = YR_PIS (HUD codes 8888/9999 = unknown, left out).

problems: 163 projects without a usable county/tract FIPS: no municipio link

files.note: OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries v2, state eq 'PR', 2116 rows -> 51 declarations. areas = distinct designated municipios (fipsCountyCode); rows with fipsCountyCode 000 are statewide and add no municipio link. ih_program = ihProgramDeclared or iaProgramDeclared on any row. municipio.fema_declarations = declarations (DR, EM, FM) designating that municipio.

OpenFEMA HousingAssistanceOwners v2 (15095 rows) + HousingAssistanceRenters v2 (10177 rows), state eq 'PR', summed from disaster x county x city x zip to disaster x municipio (county name normalised and matched to TIGER names). valid_registrations, total_inspected, approved_usd, repair_replace_usd, rental_usd = owners + renters. total_damage_usd = owners totalDamage only (the renters dataset has no dollar damage). major_damage_homes = owners with FEMA-inspected damage > $30,000 + renters with major or substantial damage. ihp_*_maria = DR-4339 row for the municipio.

problems: county "Statewide" not matched to a municipio (1 registrations left out)
disaster numbers in housing data without a declaration row: 1561, 4337

files.note: CO-OPS metadata API, water level stations with state "PR" (13). mhhw_m = MHHW - MSL from datums.json (metres on station datum). minor_flood_m = floodlevels.json nos_minor (else nws_minor), given on station datum, minus MSL. slr_2050_int_m / slr_2100_int_m = Intermediate scenario projectionRsl at 2050 / 2100 from slr_projections.json (reported in cm, converted to metres; zero at the first projection year, see data/replay/slr_projections.json baseline). 2 stations have projections.

USGS site service, active sites with instantaneous data in PR (205 sites). Stream types (site_tp_cd ST*) -> stream_gauge; site_tp_cd LK or a name starting "Lago"/"Embalse" -> reservoir; other site types left out: {"GW":40,"AT":20,"FA-STS":2,"FA-DV":1}. drainage_km2 = drain_area_va (sq mi) x 2.58998811. Municipio from county_cd.

api.weather.gov zones for area PR: 13 public forecast zones (PRZ*), 78 county zones (PRC*, one per municipio, stored as identity nws:zone). The zones payloads carry no county-to-forecast-zone relation, so municipio part_of forecast_zone (78 links) comes from the points API evaluated at each municipio's TIGER internal point, confidence 0.8.
api.weather.gov/stations?state=PR (149 observation stations, all providers; some are NDBC buoys that also appear as buoy objects).

CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 (ACS 2018-2022), layer "SVI2022 PR tract", 939 tracts; -999 = no data, left out. Tract poverty_pct = EP_POV150 (below 150% of poverty). County layer "SVI2022 PR municipio" gives official values for 78 municipios. Where no official county row exists, municipio values are aggregated from tracts: population, housing_units, households = sums of E_TOTPOP, E_HU, E_HH; svi_overall, poverty150_pct, age65_pct, disability_pct, no_health_insurance_pct = E_TOTPOP-weighted means of the tract values; no_vehicle_pct and crowding_pct = E_HH-weighted; mobile_home_pct = E_HU-weighted. svi_basis on each municipio says which applies.

NWPS gauges in the PR bounding box (118); 108 carry a usgsId and are keyed by it (1 of those are not in the USGS active real-time list and are created here); the rest are keyed nws-<lid>. Flood stages from flood.categories.*.stage converted with flood.stageUnits (ft x 0.3048); missing or negative-sentinel stages are left out. Reservoir objects get the NWS identity only (the reservoir type has no stage thresholds).
